#     prefix `glue_f2_v2_shapes`, n_shapes=14: shapes 0-6 = p=2 (BIT-IDENTICAL to glue_f2_shapes,
#     F_corr_blk max|diff| = 0.000e+00), shapes 7-13 = p=4. The power is applied to the LOCAL holonomy
#     theta_inst BEFORE the Y_lm projection (WilsonShapes::op_pow) -- so O^(4) carries the same (l,m)
#     label as O^(2) and the analysis needed NO change. Only EVEN powers may mix (theta is parity-odd).

# Columns (whitespace-separated; col 1 = ensemble dir basename, contains ckpoint_lat.<k>):
#   ensemble   output dir3 basename
#   type       massless (mRe=0) | massive (mRe!=0)
#   slot       wrapper pair-slot p<idx> (run_wrapper_redo_claude.sh); packed 2/GPU under MPS
#   L Nf gsq mRe   lattice refinement / flavors / coupling / physical mass (R=1)
#   target     compiled trajectory cap -DKMAX (at=0.2 massless L1=L2=4000 ; at=0.1 half massless=2000 ; massive L1=120 L2=80)
